research.name: ec
research.note: Terminal Git conflict resolver with ours, result and theirs panes, a live preview of the pending resolution, and a split or unified diff viewer.

effects: three-pane ours / result / theirs conflict resolver with syntax highlighting
result pane previews the selected side before it is applied ("Preview: OURS, not applied")
side-by-side old/new commit diff viewer with a file explorer pane
